Class AlloySession

java.lang.Object
org.clafer.alloy.solve.AlloySession
public final class AlloySession extends Object
An Alloy model in this JVM and its solutions: claferIG's AlloyIG.java, whose operations are the methods here rather than messages on a pipe. A solution is Alloy's XML of it, as AlloyIG sends it.

The model is parsed from its text, in memory. The solutions of a dynamic model, a trace each, are solved for one by one, without the traces given so far (next()); fork(int) and nextConfiguration() give other traces, and check(String) the counterexample of an assertion. The unsat core of the model comes from the minisat prover, claferIG's fixed one (FixedMiniSatProver).

    • unsatCore

      public List<int[]> unsatCore()
      unsatCore: the spans of the constraints of the unsat core of the model, each as {line, column, line, column + 1}, or none. Only the model has an unsat core: not the next solution, when the solutions of the model run out. Alloy reports no minimized core when it finds the model unsatisfiable without solving, e.g., [ some b ] and [ no b ], so the core is not checked by its size.
